confidence_notes: Recent Siem Reap price indexes support the meal, coffee, and beer estimates. Cocktail pricing is less certain; wine is estimated at roughly 3.5 times the local draft-beer price. Accommodation anchors are broad model estimates and vary by season and property.
comparable_city_reasoning: No external city comparator used. Food and drink estimates use Siem Reap-specific price indexes; lodging estimates reflect general knowledge of budget accommodation in a Cambodian tourism hub.
